title: High-Throughput Discovery of Ferrocene Mechanophores with Enhanced Reactivity and Network Toughening
summary: High-Throughput Discovery of Ferrocene Mechanophores with Enhanced Reactivity and Network Toughening. Screening identified over one hundred candidate ferrocene mechanophores, with design principles. Computational screening was reported validated experimentally at polymer strand and network level (preprint). Evidence limits: Preprint; peer review and quantitative experimental details not assessed. Reviewed from Europe PMC abstract only.
